title: Countdown loop
prompt: The function below is intended to return the list [n, n-1, ..., 1]. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number where the bug is located.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: Test: countdown(3)
evidence.body: The call does not terminate. Expected: [3, 2, 1]. Actual: the process keeps appending values and runs until it is stopped.

evidence.title: Trace of the first iterations
evidence.body:
n = 3 -> append 3 -> n += 1 -> n = 4
n = 4 -> append 4 -> n += 1 -> n = 5
n = 5 -> append 5 -> ...

The counter moves away from the loop condition instead of toward it.

recommendation.text: There is a bug on line 4. The loop condition should be n >= 0 so that the countdown includes zero and terminates.

annotations.notes: The recommendation points to the wrong line: the increment on line 5 is the bug. Replace before freezing.
